name: Paleozoic Olenoides
effectText: Target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy it. Once per Chain, when a Trap Card is activated while this card is in your GY: Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster (Aqua/WATER/Level 2/ATK 1200/DEF 0) (this card is NOT treated as a Trap). If Summoned this way, this card is unaffected by monster effects, also banish it when it leaves the field.
